newsitem.title: GERMANY: Securities main feature in German cap account - Buba.
newsitem.headline: Securities main feature in German cap account - Buba.

text.p: The provisional fall in Germany's capital account surplus in September was largely due to fluctuations in the level of cross-border securities deals, the German Bundesbank said in a statement on Tuesday.

Net capital imports for September fell to 4.5 billion marks in September from 17.8 billion marks the month before. Foreign purchases of securities fell to 7.4 billion marks in September from 18.9 billion marks in August, it said.
German investors in September acquired foreign securities worth 2.9 billion marks compared to just 1.1 billion marks in August.
Long-term capital exports in the form of direct investments fell to a net 400 million marks compared to 2.8 billion marks in August.
Among credit transactions by non-banks, a net 6.0 billion marks flowed into the country, while transactions involving credit institutes accounted for 3.0 billion marks of out-flows.
The Bundesbank earlier said that the German capital account surplus narrowed on a provisional basis to 6.7 billion marks in September from 13.5 billion in August.
